fields.description: Focus timer with tasks, planned breaks and background music.
fields.intro: Ryri is a focus app for your phone: pick a task and a session length, and it times your session and plans your breaks, with background music in the mood you choose. It started as our Hack the North 2024 project, and I redesigned it for phones on my own.
fields.summary: Designing a focus app for phones that keeps your task, a session timer with planned breaks and background music on one screen.
fields.overview: Ryri takes you from setting up a session to focusing on one task, with a chat with Ryri and your focus history a tap away. It’s a side project I designed on my own in Figma, from December 2024 to January 2025.

sections.title: Origin
sections.heading: From Hack the North to phones

children.text: Ryri began as our team’s project at Hack the North 2024. Afterwards, I took the idea further as a side project and redesigned it for phones on my own, over December and January.
The app follows one loop: set up a session, focus on one task and finish it. Setting up and focusing each get their own screen, and the chat and your focus history are a tap away from both.
Every session starts on the Ready screen, which asks “Ready to lock in?” and holds the three choices you make first: how long, which task and what to listen to.
Pick 30, 60, 90 or 120 minutes, or nudge the time with − and +. Under the time, Ryri tells you how many breaks you’ll get: one for 30 or 60 minutes, and two for 90 or 120.

content.alt: Four Session length cards in a grid: 30 mins and 60 mins with “You’ll have one break”, 90 mins and 120 mins with “You’ll have two breaks”, each with the matching chip highlighted in a row of 30, 60, 90 and 120
content.caption: The four session lengths and their breaks.

children.text: Below that is your task list, each task with its due date. Tap + or Create a task to add one: give it a title, a date and a reminder, then Save task.

content.alt: Two iPhones with an arrow: the Ready screen with Session length, Select Task and a cyan Create a task button, then the Create a task sheet over the dimmed Ready screen, with Add a title, Date Sep 16, Reminder On and a yellow Save task button
content.caption: Create a task opens a sheet over the Ready screen.

children.text: Ambience plays background music in one of four moods: Zen, Nature, Upbeat and Flow. Pick one before you start, and change it any time during the session.
Once you pick a task, the button at the bottom turns from Create a task into Start session. Tap it, and the Ready screen becomes the Focus screen.

content.alt: Two iPhones with an arrow: the Ready screen with CS115 Assignment picked and a yellow Start session button, then the Focus screen with Ryri is active, Currently focusing on CS115 Assignment, a row of bars partly filled in yellow, 20 mins complete, 25 mins left, Up next: 5 min break, Ambience and I’m done!
content.caption: Pick a task, then Start session.

children.text: The task you’re working on sits in the top card, under “Currently focusing on”. A row of bars fills in with yellow as time passes, with the minutes done on one side, the minutes left on the other and your next break underneath.

Ambience stays on this screen, so you can change the mood mid-session. Below it, your other tasks wait in a list, with a nudge to start another one after this. When you finish, I’m done! ends the session and takes you back to the Ready screen.

Ryri also talks back. The pill under the title is its status: “Hi Winston, let’s focus!” before a session, and “Ryri is active” during one. Its chat icon opens Chat with Ryri, where you can type a question or tap the mic to speak.
In the chat, Ryri asks you to use it more often, because it wants to help you focus.

content.alt: An iPhone showing Chat with Ryri: casual messages back and forth, from “Whats up big man ryri” to a sad face, an Ask a question field and a yellow mic button

children.text: The account icon in the top corner opens Your account. Along with your name, email, Edit account and Log out, it adds up your all-time focus and keeps a focus history: every task you’ve focused on, with its date and a delete button.

content.alt: An iPhone showing Your account: What’s up Winston Zhao, the email, Edit account and Log out, Thanks for using Ryri!, All time focus 69 hours, and a Focus history of five tasks with dates and delete icons
